title: Frog with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='78' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#3cb043'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='78' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#3cb043'/>
  <!-- front feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2e8b2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='86' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#2e8b2e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#4cd964'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#b8f2b0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#4cd964'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='13' fill='#4cd964'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='13' fill='#4cd964'/>
  <!-- eyes white -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='9' fill='#f0fff0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='9' fill='#f0fff0'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='27' r='5' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='27' r='5' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='23' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='23' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='30' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M29 20 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <path d='M71 20 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q50 60 62 50' stroke='#2e8b2e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#2e8b2e'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#2e8b2e'/>
</svg>
